courses.overview: 從晶矽電池互連、封裝應力及模組失效延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend crystalline-silicon interconnection, package stress and module failures to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 薄膜太陽電池模組製造
related.why: 模組皆需封裝及環境可靠度
related.whyEn: Both modules need packaging and environmental reliability
related.transfer: 模組皆需封裝及環境可靠度
related.transferEn: Both modules need packaging and environmental reliability
related.difference: 薄膜以單片整合互連而非離散矽電池焊帶
related.differenceEn: Thin films use monolithic interconnection rather than discrete-cell ribbons
practice: 以「電池架構」為起點，畫出本課與「薄膜太陽電池模組製造」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「薄膜以單片整合互連而非離散矽電池焊帶」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from cell architecture and mark shared/redefined boundaries with thin-film solar-module manufacturing.
For the difference "Thin films use monolithic interconnection rather than discrete-cell ribbons", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.

courses.summary: 晶矽太陽電池模組製造以晶矽電池互連、封裝應力及模組失效連結材料、元件與系統層。地圖顯示可追溯的供應鏈或研究代表點，並非宣稱發明地。
courses.summaryEn: Crystalline-silicon solar-module manufacturing connects materials, components and systems through crystalline-silicon interconnection, package stress and module failures. The map marks a traceable supply-chain or research reference, not a claimed invention site.
courses.connection: 由電池架構走到額定及追溯，比較理想模型與實際驗證的交接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect cell architecture to rating and traceability, comparing ideal models with verification handoff.
